title: 第四十章 盛世红妆嫁暗煞隐轮回第三十九章 百年尘缘尽归途赴山河
lines: 大靖京城，举国沸扬。
自景帝赐婚圣旨下达那日起，整座帝都便陷入了绵延半月的盛大喜庆之中。
百年难遇的盛世姻缘，平定千年祸乱的救世圣女，权倾天下的无双摄政王，无人不盼、无人不颂这一场天作之合。
皇家内务府全程督办大婚仪典，十里红妆连夜筹备，绵延从摄政王府直通丞相府，铺遍京城最繁华的整条长街。
绸缎皆是江南上等云锦，正红鎏金，绣满龙凤呈祥纹样；沿街悬遍万年红烛、缠枝喜结，春风拂过，满城红影摇曳，暖意漫彻京华。
相府上下，日日喜气盈盈。
汀兰院被装点得精致烂漫，窗棂雕花贴满双喜，庭前海棠尽数盛放，灼灼芳华，衬得满院温柔缱绻。
春桃捧着叠叠崭新的嫁衣入内，眉眼笑得弯弯，难掩满心欢喜：“小姐！这是内务府连夜赶制的大婚喜服，金线织龙凤，珍珠缀云纹，是大靖开国以来最华贵的一套婚服！”
铺开嫁衣，流光溢彩。
正红锦袍端庄大气，领口袖口绣着栩栩如生的金龙玉凤，针脚细密万千，每一寸皆是顶尖工艺，尊贵无双。
沈清鸢指尖轻轻拂过柔软锦料，眼底漾开浅浅温柔笑意。
前世，她葬身火海，孤苦无依，满身冤屈，潦草落幕。
今生，她挣脱宿命，洗尽沉冤，得良人相伴，得盛世荣宠，得世间最盛大的圆满。
两世落差，恍如大梦一场。
午后暖阳透过窗棂，落在少女清丽眉眼上，温柔动人。
一道修长玄色身影踏着暖阳步入庭院，褪去了朝堂肃杀、战场锋芒，周身只剩温柔缱绻的暖意。
萧聿辞遣退所有下人，独留二人独处院中。
这些日大婚筹备繁杂，他处理完所有军政要务，便日日赶来相府，陪她静待婚期，寸心温柔，尽数予她一人。
他缓步走到她身前，垂眸凝视她含笑的眉眼，眼底盛着独独予她的万千星河温柔。
“紧张吗？”他低声询问，指尖轻轻摩挲她微凉的鬓角，动作宠溺至极。
沈清鸢轻轻摇头，抬眸望他，眼底星光澄澈：“有你在，便不紧张。”
历经生死并肩，踏过千年风雨，闯过血海棋局，世间再无任何事能让她心生惶恐。
唯有他，是她此生唯一的心安归处。
萧聿辞低低轻笑，俯身轻轻将她拥入怀中，怀抱宽阔温热，牢牢将她圈在满院春光与暖意之中。
“往后，不用再披风霜，不用再涉险境。”
他下巴轻抵她的发顶，嗓音缱绻温柔，字字郑重，落进心底：“朝堂风雨、世间纷争、千年宿命，皆由我来挡。”
“你只需要岁岁安然，日日欢喜，做我萧聿辞一生捧在掌心的妻。”
自年少权倾朝野，他冷心冷情，杀伐果断，坐拥万里山河，从未对谁心软动容。
唯独遇见她，两世羁绊，生死相随，让他冰冷半生，从此满世温柔。
沈清鸢乖乖靠在他怀中，听着他沉稳有力的心跳，唇角笑意愈发浓郁。
两人静静相拥在暖阳庭院，春风拂过花枝，落英簌簌，温柔落满肩头，岁月温柔，现世安稳。
三日后，大婚正日。
吉日良辰，天光破晓，万里晴空澄澈万里，祥云绕城，瑞气漫天。
天未亮，京城万人空巷，百姓齐聚长街两侧，争相围观这一场亘古未有的盛世大婚。
辰时正刻。
丞相府朱门大开。
一身大红嫁衣的沈清鸢，头戴九珠凤冠，凤眸清丽绝色，容颜倾城无双。褪去了往日的清冷淡然，眉眼间染满娇羞温柔，一身红妆，艳绝京华，惊艳山河万里。
凤冠霞帔，盛世红妆，是天下女子最极致的圆满。
春桃扶着她缓步踏出府门，十里红妆铺展眼前，绵延数里，鎏金映日，红彻天际。
锣鼓喧天，喜乐震天，百官列队相迎，禁军沿街护礼，威仪盛大，无人能及。
长街尽头，玄红喜马之上。
萧聿辞一身大红喜服，褪去玄色肃冷，身姿卓然挺拔，眉眼俊美凌厉，往日杀伐凛冽的眼底，只剩满目温柔，遥遥望着缓步而来的心上人。
一眼相望，一眼万年。
content_en:
In the capital city of Dajing, the whole country was in an uproar.
From the day Emperor Jing issued the edict of marriage, the entire imperial capital fell into a grand celebration that lasted for half a month.
A once-in-a-century marriage, a saintly savior who quelled a millennium of troubles, and an unparalleled regent with overwhelming power. Everyone looks forward to and praises this match made in heaven.
The Royal Household Office supervised the entire wedding ceremony, and preparations were made overnight, stretching from the Regent's Palace to the Prime Minister's Palace, and covering the entire most prosperous long street in the capital.
The silks and satins are all made of the finest cloud brocade from the south of the Yangtze River, gilded in pure red, and embroidered with dragons and phoenixes in auspicious patterns; thousands of years of red candles are hung along the street, and branches are tied to tie the knot. The spring breeze blows, and the red shadows all over the city sway, and warmth permeates the capital.
The prime minister's house is full of joy every day.
The Tinglan Courtyard is decorated exquisitely, the window lattice is covered with carved double happiness, and the begonias are in full bloom in front of the courtyard, burning with youth and making the whole courtyard tender and affectionate.
Chuntao came in holding stacks of brand-new wedding clothes, her eyebrows were smiling, and she could not hide her joy: "Miss! This is the wedding dress that the Ministry of Internal Affairs rushed to make overnight. It is woven with gold threads, dragons and phoenixes, and pearls are embellished with cloud patterns. It is the most luxurious wedding dress since the founding of Dajing!"
Spread out the wedding dress and it will be full of brilliance.
The red brocade robe is dignified and elegant, with lifelike golden dragons and jade phoenixes embroidered on the collar and cuffs. The stitches are intricate and every inch is made of top-notch craftsmanship, making it unparalleled in dignity.
Shen Qingyuan's fingertips gently brushed the soft brocade material, and a gentle smile appeared in her eyes.
In her previous life, she was buried in a sea of ​​fire, left alone and helpless, full of grievances, and ended abruptly.
In this life, she breaks away from her fate, washes away all her grievances, gets the company of her beloved, gets the glory of the prosperous age, and achieves the greatest perfection in the world.
The gap between the two lives is like a big dream.
The warm afternoon sun shines through the window lattice and falls on the girl's beautiful brows, making her gentle and moving.
A slender black figure stepped into the courtyard under the warm sunshine, losing the solemnity of the court and the edge of the battlefield, leaving only the gentle and lingering warmth around him.
Xiao Yu dismissed all his servants, leaving the two of them alone in the courtyard.
The preparations for the wedding were complicated these days. After handling all the important military and political affairs, he rushed to the Prime Minister's Mansion every day to accompany her and wait for the wedding. He was gentle and devoted to her.
He walked slowly to her, lowered his eyes and stared at her smiling brows, his eyes filled with the gentleness of thousands of stars that he only gave to her.
"Are you nervous?" He asked in a low voice, gently stroking her cool temples with his fingertips, his movements extremely pampering.
Shen Qingyuan shook her head gently and looked up at him, her eyes clear with stars: "With you here, I won't be nervous."
After experiencing life and death side by side, going through thousands of years of wind and rain, and going through a blood-sea chess game, nothing in the world could make her fearful.
Only he is the only place of peace for her in this life.
Xiao Yuci chuckled softly, leaned over and gently hugged her into his arms. His arms were wide and warm, tightly encircling her in the spring light and warmth of the courtyard.
"From now on, there will be no need to wear the wind and frost, and there will no longer be any danger."
His chin rested lightly on the top of her hair, his voice was gentle and gentle, and his words were solemn, falling into his heart: "I will stop the wind and rain in the court, the disputes in the world, and the fate of a thousand years."
"You just need to be safe and happy every day, and be the wife that I, Xiao Yuci, hold in the palm of your hand for the rest of your life."
Since he was in power at a young age, he has been cold-hearted and decisive in killing. He has thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, and has never been soft-hearted towards anyone.
Only meeting her, the bond between two lives, life and death, made him cold for half his life, and he became gentle for the rest of his life.
Shen Qingyuan leaned obediently in his arms, listening to his steady and powerful heartbeat, the smile on her lips grew stronger.
The two hugged each other quietly in the warm sun courtyard, the spring breeze blew through the flower branches, the fallen flowers rustled, and gentleness fell on their shoulders. The years were gentle and the world was stable.
Three days later, the wedding day.
On an auspicious day, the sky breaks at dawn, the sky is clear and clear for thousands of miles, auspicious clouds surround the city, and the sky is full of auspiciousness.
Before dawn, the streets in the capital were empty, and people gathered on both sides of the long street, vying to watch this unprecedented grand wedding.
The hour is right.
The royal gate of the Prime Minister's Mansion is wide open.
Shen Qingyuan was dressed in a bright red wedding dress, with a nine-beaded phoenix crown on her head, her phoenix eyes were stunningly beautiful, and her appearance was unparalleled. The coldness and indifference of the past have faded away, her eyebrows are filled with shyness and gentleness, and she is dressed in red makeup. She is stunningly beautiful in the capital, stunning the mountains and rivers.
The phoenix crown and harem, the prosperous red makeup, are the ultimate perfection of women in the world.
Chuntao supported her and stepped out of the house slowly. Ten miles of red makeup spread before her eyes, stretching for several miles. The sun was gilded and the sky was red.
The gongs and drums were noisy, the joy was overwhelming, hundreds of officials lined up to greet them, and the imperial guards marched along the street to protect the ceremony. The majesty was grand and unparalleled.
At the end of the long street, atop a black horse.
Xiao Yuci was dressed in a bright red wedding dress. The black and cold colors faded away. She had a tall and tall figure, handsome and sharp eyebrows. Her eyes that used to be fierce and murderous were only filled with tenderness, looking at her sweetheart who was slowly coming from a distance.
One look at each other, one look for thousands of years.
title_en: Chapter 40: The red dowry in the prosperous age and the hidden evil reincarnation Chapter 39: Returning to the mountains and rivers after a hundred years of mortal bonding
